boar.name: Wild Boar
texts: A wild boar charges!
Tusks gleaming — a boar attacks!

wolf.name: Wolf
texts: A lone wolf emerges from the brush!
Yellow eyes in the dark — wolf!

bandit.name: Bandit
texts: Ambushed by a bandit!
A hooded figure demands gold — fight!

bear.name: Bear
texts: A mountain bear blocks the path!
Massive claws swipe from a cave entrance!

mountain_troll.name: Mountain Troll
texts: A troll throws boulders from above!
The ground shakes — troll incoming!

cave_troll.name: Cave Troll
texts: A troll lurches from the shadows!
Stench fills the tunnel — cave troll!

giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
texts: Webs everywhere — giant spider!
Eight legs skitter across the ceiling!

basilisk.name: Basilisk
texts: Don't look it in the eyes!
A basilisk slithers from a crevice!

wraith_scout.name: Wraith Scout
texts: A chilling presence materializes!
The air freezes — wraith!

skeleton_knight.name: Skeleton Knight
texts: Bones rattle to attention — a fallen knight rises!
An ancient warrior guards this hall!

cursed_guardian.name: Cursed Guardian
texts: A massive armored figure blocks the way!
The guardian's eyes glow with dark fire!

demon_scout.name: Demon Scout
texts: Fire and brimstone — a demon appears!
Claws of hellfire slash the air!

hellhound.name: Hellhound
texts: Burning paws scorch the ground!
A pack of hellhounds! One charges!

infernal.name: Infernal
texts: The ground splits open — an Infernal rises!
Pure malice given form — an Infernal!
